analogy.source: A transit map can bend every line if stops and transfer stations stay connected.
analogy.invariant: Preserve named terminal adjacency and junction incidence under a change in drawing style.
analogy.counterexample: An overpass and an interchange can paint the same intersecting centreline pixels. The junction mark or an independent terminal graph must disambiguate them.
analogy.claim: A conjecture for judging drawings. Synthetic fixtures are simulations. Program outputs are measurements under the specified fixtures. A graph equality check proves equality only of its two given graphs.
